name: Vigil arsenal VW3: heroic rifles, sidearms and power blades
mesh_policy: re-mesh the SDF coarser until under the checker budget; no decimation of print meshes (3dada lesson)
registry: tools/arsenal3.py WEAPONS3 (VW3-01..14), BLADES3 (VB3-01..06); tools/armory.py and tools/arsenal.py unchanged
frame: mm at print scale; guns: x to the muzzle, z up, origin = main grip / fist centre; blades: grip along +z (blade up), origin = grip centre

blade_grip.note: inside the exosuit.fist() gauntlet (rbox half 0.85 x 1.0 x 1.05, r 0.55) closed on the grip axis

hand_fit.fore_grips: 1.0 x 1.1 mm vertical grips / 1.0 mm bars: the same fist closes on them (FORE3 in tools/arsenal3.py)

exaggerations: receivers 2.0-2.24 mm wide and up to 3.4 mm deep: about 1.3x a true 1:56 rifle so seams and vents read at arm's length
panel seams 0.45 x 0.3 mm (a true 6 mm seam is 0.1 mm); vent slots 0.45 mm with 0.5 mm lands
rail teeth 0.5 mm on a 1.0 mm pitch (true picatinny pitch 0.09 mm at 1:56)
blade edges are 0.5 mm flats, blade spines 1.0-1.3 mm (true sword edge ~0 mm, spine 0.1 mm at 1:56)
grips sized to the Vigil gauntlet (1.0 x 1.1 mm), not to a scaled human hand

catalog.revision_note: VW3 series: 14 chunky heroic guns + 6 VB3 power blades, loose parts sized for the Vigil hands
catalog.description: Third-generation Vigilant weapons, chunkier and more detailed than VW2: VW3-01 Saker line rifle, VW3-02 Caliver marksman bullpup, VW3-03 Serpentine grenadier bullpup, VW3-04 Minion bullpup carbine, VW3-05 Falconet carbine, VW3-06 Basilisk battle rifle, VW3-07 Petronel assault rifle (pump launcher), VW3-08 Hackbut heavy rifle, VW3-09 Fowler las carbine, VW3-10 Arquebus assault rifle, VW3-11 Musketoon combat shotgun, VW3-12 Snaphance SMG, VW3-13 Dag heavy pistol, VW3-14 Wheellock machine pistol; and power blades VB3-01 Thorn, VB3-02 Tulwar sabre, VB3-03 Estoc great-blade, VB3-04 Flamberge, VB3-05 Falx cleaver, VB3-06 Keel sword. Bullpup and conventional layouts, integrated optics and large scopes, under-barrel launchers, vertical and angled fore grips, boxy receivers with big seams and vent rhythm, separate magazines; pierced and stepped blades with sweeping guards, segmented grips and ring pommels.

buildNotes: Defined in tools/arsenal3.py (WEAPONS3, BLADES3); built by source/build.py on a 0.05 mm SDF grid, re-meshed coarser per part only if over the 285k-triangle checker budget (pitch per part in reports/build.json).
Every pistol grip is the VW grip block (1.0 x 1.1 x 2.0 mm at the origin) and every blade grip a 1.0 mm core with 1.26 mm rings, so figures hold VW3/VB3 parts with the existing gauntlets.
Blade edges are 0.5 mm flats (no knife edges); seams 0.45 x 0.3 mm, vents 0.45 x 0.32 mm, rail teeth 0.5 mm; see DESIGN-LOG.md.
catalog.limitations: Procedural designs; printability is a heuristic screen (unified-CAD-MCP), not a test print. No STEP export: FreeCAD is not installed on the build host (WSL), so cad/ holds a SKIPPED note instead of an assembly STEP.

opening_r_mm._note: arsenal3.open_slivers: morphological opening of the SDF solid (M6); blades keep crisp 0.5 mm edge flats and are fixed at the source instead (M8)
